convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for XWAMI indicator and CDynamicMatrixGrid money management library (.mqh), both of which are external dependencies requiring custom replication in Python. The money management is complex and multi-layered.

other_exits: CDynamicMatrixGrid manages position closure as part of its multi-lot money management grid logic, which may close or modify positions outside standard SL/TP

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MoneyFixRisk<0: fixed lot size = abs(MoneyFixRisk); when MoneyFixRisk>0: risk as percentage of deposit per trade, lot calculated from SL distance; sizing delegated to CDynamicMatrixGrid library

custom_logic_notes: Uses CDynamicMatrixGrid from DynamicMatrixGrid.mqh for money management - this is a complex grid-based position management system that handles lot sizing, grid spacing, and position closure beyond simple SL/TP. Signal uses completed bar [1] values to avoid repainting. On opposite signal, existing position is closed before new one is opened.
python_conversion_notes: XWAMI custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately since it uses iCustom(). The CDynamicMatrixGrid money management library is the hardest part - it implements a dynamic grid/matrix sizing system that must be fully understood and replicated. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be handled in SL/TP calculations. Signal logic itself is simple (XWAMI zero-line crossover on completed bar), but the money management wrapper makes full conversion complex.
